name: Electric Finish
description: High-energy celebration with sharp contrast, diagonal motion, and a stadium-light glow.
typography_guidance: Use condensed uppercase display type with a short, oversized headline.

layout_notes.landscape: Place the athlete on the left, headline and offer on the right, and logo in the lower-right safe area.
layout_notes.portrait: Stack the athlete above the headline, with offer and call to action in the lower third.

name: Precision Pulse
description: Focused, geometric composition inspired by targets, score lines, and controlled motion.
typography_guidance: Use clean sans-serif type with measured spacing and one emphasized numeric detail.

layout_notes.landscape: Use concentric graphic accents behind the athlete and align copy in a compact left-side grid.
layout_notes.portrait: Center the athlete inside a target-inspired frame and keep copy in two concise bands.

name: Street Surge
description: Expressive urban collage using layered color, hand-drawn accents, and a sense of upward movement.
typography_guidance: Mix heavy sans-serif headlines with one handwritten accent, while preserving readability.

layout_notes.landscape: Crop the athlete dynamically across the center and anchor the logo and offer in opposite corners.
layout_notes.portrait: Use a full-height action crop, with headline above and a sticker-like offer panel below.
